methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $250M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Drones & Autonomous (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 5 same-sector peers exist in Drones & Autonomous, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Rhoman Aerospace is a Seed-stage company operating in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The broader comp universe consists of 6 private firms including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air; no public comparables exist in this narrow segment.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable triangulation approach. Using a $250M total raised proxy as the base and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the subsequent financing stage yields an implied valuation of $625M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient data—while 5 same-sector peers exist, none satisfied the filtering criteria for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparison (minimum 3 required), making a reliance on all-sector median medians inappropriate.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $531M to $719M, with a median of $625M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the single applicable method output. Key uncertainties include the validity of the $250M total raised proxy as a reliable anchor for a Seed-stage company and the absence of narrow peer data to cross-validate the stage-progression assumption. Until additional Seed or Series A comps in the Drones & Autonomous sector materialize, or until the company's financials and traction metrics become available, the range carries meaningful estimation risk.
